settings.question: Where do you deliver?
settings.answer: All across India, and worldwide too. Enter your pincode or address at checkout, and it'll confirm right away whether we can reach you - and if we can, your order's on its way from the mountains.

settings.question: How long will my order take to arrive?
settings.answer: Most orders leave us within 24 to 48 hours. How long they take to reach you after that depends on your distance and the courier, but nothing sits around waiting on our end - your parcel gets moving quickly.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: The moment it ships, a tracking link lands in your inbox - give it a day or so to wake up and start showing movement. If you'd rather just ask, WhatsApp us on +91 84286 11319, and we'll look for you.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, to 70+ countries. Choose yours from the selector at checkout - if it's on the list, we ship there. Shipping cost is always shown before you pay. Import duties charged by your own country aren't ours to control.

settings.question: Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
settings.answer: We don't run COD on our own site, but we've made sure it's still an option for you. Our products are stocked on Amazon.in and Flipkart, where cash on delivery comes as standard - so if you'd rather pay when it arrives, order us there and you're sorted.

settings.question: What payment methods can I use on your website?
settings.answer: Whatever suits you - UPI, cards, netbanking, wallets - they all work. And if you're stocking up on something bigger, there's a no-cost EMI option on UPI, so you can spread it out without paying a rupee more than the price.

settings.question: What if I'm not home when the delivery arrives?
settings.answer: The courier will try three times before heading back - so no single missed knock loses your order. Just keep your phone within reach: if they can't reach you at all and the parcel comes back to us, a return charge may apply.

settings.question: My order says delivered, but I haven't received it.
settings.answer: Tell us quickly, within 48 hours of that "delivered" ping, and email support@mypahadidukan.com with your order number. While it's fresh, we can chase the courier and dig into what happened; leave it longer, and the trail goes cold.

settings.question: Can I return a product?
settings.answer: Depends what it is. Most of what we sell is food, and food can't go back on a shelf once it's left us, so edible items aren't returnable as a rule. If something turns up damaged, spoiled, or clearly wrong, that's different. Send us a photo within 48 hours and we'll sort it out.

settings.question: Can I cancel or change my order?
settings.answer:
If it hasn't been dispatched, write to support@mypahadidukan.com straight away, and we'll do what we can. Note: we pack within a day or two, so the window is short.

One thing worth knowing: orders with food in them can't be cancelled once they're confirmed, because we start pulling stock for them immediately.

settings.question: How do refunds work, and when will I get my money?
settings.answer:
Once your return has reached us and passed inspection, the refund goes back the way you paid - same card, same UPI, same account. Allow 7 to 10 business days from that point.

Shipping charges aren't refunded, unless the mistake was ours. And if we ask you to post something back and can't arrange a pickup, we'll reimburse the courier cost up to ₹125 - just send us the receipt.

settings.question: I refused a prepaid order at the door. What happens to my money?
settings.answer: We'll give delivery one more go first. If it still can't reach you, we cancel the order and refund you to the original payment method once the parcel is back with us, minus the shipping, which isn't refundable unless the error was ours.

settings.question: My order arrived damaged. What should I do?
settings.answer: Sorry it turned up that way - send us a photo and your order number at support@mypahadidukan.com, and we'll take it from there. We look at every one of these ourselves, and we'll make it right with a replacement or a refund.

settings.question: The packaging looked tampered with at delivery.
settings.answer: Trust that instinct - if a parcel looks like it's been opened or messed with, don't sign for it. Turn the courier away and tell us straight away, and we'll get a fresh one out to you or refund you. Better safe.

settings.question: I received the wrong product.
settings.answer: That's on us, and we'll fix it. Send a quick photo of what actually turned up, along with your order number, to support@mypahadidukan.com - and we'll get the right thing heading your way as fast as we can.

settings.question: How long do I have to report a damaged or wrong item?
settings.answer: 48 hours from delivery. That's the window in our returns policy, as after that the courier trail goes cold, and there's much less we can do. A photo and your order number are all we need to start.

settings.question: Are your products really pure, or is this like every other "Himalayan" label?
settings.answer: Fair question; this whole category runs on people trusting a word on a label. So we don't ask for blind trust: our own products are batch-tested, with the reports right on the page, and the rest come from makers we know by name.

settings.question: Are your products lab-tested?
settings.answer: Our own line is, every single batch, with the reports right there on the product page. Most of our partner makers are small, traditional producers who don't run formal lab tests, so there we vouch for them the honest way: we know them, and we know how they work.

settings.question: Can these products cure or treat a health issue?
settings.answer: No, and anyone who tells you otherwise is selling a story. These are foods and honest mountain produce, not medicine, and they're not meant to treat or cure anything. Enjoy them for what they are, and for anything medical, see a doctor.

settings.question: How do I store everything, and how long will it keep?
settings.answer: Cool, dry, and sealed is the short answer - away from sunlight and strong smells. Beyond that, it depends on what you've got: some things like oils or juices want the fridge once opened, so it's worth a glance at the pack.

settings.question: Someone called asking me to pay for my prepaid order - is that you?
settings.answer: No, and please don't pay them. We will never ring you asking for money on an order you've already paid for - that's a scam, plain and simple. Our only real numbers are +91 84286 11319 and +91 85699 49587; treat anything else as suspect.

settings.question: Do you have a physical store I can visit?
settings.answer: Yes, a few of them. Noida and Lucknow each have a grocery and tasting counter, and Dehradun is our flagship, with a tasting space and workshop too. Rishikesh, Shimla, and Manali are on the way. There's nothing like seeing and smelling it all in person.

settings.question: Do you take bulk, corporate, or gifting orders?
settings.answer: Gladly. Whether it's a big personal order, corporate gifting, or festive hampers straight from the hills, write to us at support@mypahadidukan.com, and we'll put together something that fits what you have in mind.

settings.question: How do I reach an actual person?
settings.answer: The quickest way is WhatsApp, +91 84286 11319, where we usually reply within minutes. For anything more detailed, including any grievance or complaint, email support@mypahadidukan.com. Either way, it's a real person on the other end, glad to help.

settings.question: I make something in the hills - can I sell it through you?
settings.answer: We'd genuinely love to hear from you - finding makers tucked away in the mountains and bringing their work to the world is the whole point of what we do. Write to us at support@mypahadidukan.com with a little about what you make and where, and we'll take it from there.

settings.title: Talk to the Hills
settings.subtitle: Something's gone sideways? Tell us, we'll fix it fast. Something's gone lovely? Tell us that too - good news makes our day up here.

Most things you'd ask us are answered here. 
The rest? We're a message away.
